extracted.name: Lemonade
extracted.description: Lemonade is a classic for a reason — it's tart, bright, and refreshing, and perfect whether you're poolside or opting for the respite of the indoors.
instruction_lines: In a 2 quart pitcher, combine the lemon juice, water, and sugar. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Chill in refrigerator until ready to serve.
